message: Hey, can you shoot Kemal Kowalski an email saying tomorrow's dinner is now at 9pm? Also, please set a reminder for 8pm tomorrow so I remember to head out.

ia_history.text: You're welcome. I'm here if anything comes up.

notes: An email and a reminder: two agents. Neither exists yet (Kemal's threads are about other things), so create both; one agent doing both is merged_intents. Reminder lookalikes share 'dinner' or the evening hour. Slots: create naming Kemal Kowalski; create (the reminder). Graded on structure: one dispatch per slot, each to its slot's target, a create naming its person (full name or email); wording is not graded.
original_message: Email Kemal Kowalski that tomorrow's dinner has moved to 9pm, and set a reminder for me at 8pm tomorrow to leave for dinner.
